proposed_rules.trigger: A pricing/'Package' landing page whose body is one long [2x1]-tagged text region describing the offering, with no repeating card/feature structure.
proposed_rules.decision: Map the body as plain default-content (headings + paragraphs) rather than a structured block; keep only the hero background and FAQ as modeled components. Rejected alternative: splitting the description into a 'package-details' block table.
proposed_rules.rationale: The content is continuous prose specific to this package, not a reusable multi-instance structure; forcing it into a block table would add authoring friction with no reuse benefit.
